Set a CLI setting: api_url (the API server), web_url (the dashboard) or default_project (a project
id; 'voidhash switch' sets it by name).

With --profile the value is stored in that profile and overrides the base setting while the profile
is active.

Usage:
  voidhash config set <key> <value> [flags]

Arguments:
  key    The setting: api_url, web_url or default_project
  value  Its new value

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash config set api_url http://localhost:8787
  voidhash config set web_url https://voidhash.localhost --profile local
